title: Studio action form: no row for the new action refusals catalogue (after #34273)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: out-of-scope finding (class b) of PR #34719 (Fixes #34273), accepted as a follow-up by its contract review (comment 6947246959). Dedupe: `Studio action form refusals`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits #34273) · domain:ui · Blocked-by #34273

## What is missing

PR #34719 adds an optional `refusals` key to an action (`ActionSchema.refusals`, entries per `ActionRefusalSchema`), so an action body can refuse in the caller's language through a declared catalogue. The Studio action form has no row for `refusals`; the reconciliation ledger carries an omit row for it. Following the `hook.texts` precedent, add the row (code, message, status, reasons) to the Studio action form and retire the omit row.
